caption:
Instagram is throwing up to half a million dollars at YouTube creators to post long-form videos on its new Features product. Buying your way into the room is easy, but making people stay without a real ad revenue plan is the hard part. Would you switch platforms for a big check? 👇

@youtube @instagram

Source: Business Insider

#Instagram #CreatorEconomy #YouTube #SocialMediaNews #ContentCreators

post.news: Instagram is offering select creators up to $500,000 to post long-form videos on its new Features product.
post.take: Paying creators half a million dollars to copy YouTube is like buying friends for your new clubhouse.
post.insight: Platforms can buy initial creator content with huge checks, but long-term success still needs sustainable ad revenue sharing like YouTube's Partner Program.
